title: NeuroFlow Extension Registry
description: Authoritative list of registered NeuroFlow extension namespaces. New entries are added by pull request to neuroflow-spec; the project maintainers act as registrar (cf. the NIfTI extension-code registry). See specification Section 28.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support.

namespace.description: The registered namespace. For extension-object metadata this is the extensions{} key (e.g. "niivue/ui"); for extension types this is the type namespace root (e.g. "neurovue").

maintainer.description: Owning project or person responsible for the namespace.

contact.description: URL or email for the maintainer.

schema.description: Filename of the JSON Schema for this namespace, relative to schemas/0.1/extensions/.

reservedTypes.description: Extension type strings (namespace:name) this namespace defines and reserves.
